description: Exact-prefix history tree of tracked-corpus games in which Skyrocoster played Black and play began 1. e4 c6; descriptive whole-game outcomes, not move quality.

generated_from.root_cohort_rule: Tracked-corpus games with the resolved player as Black whose first two plies are exactly e4 then c6 from the standard initial position; exact prefixes preserved, transposing orders stay separate.

definitions.node_id: n + first 16 hex chars of sha256 over the U+001F-joined SAN prefix
definitions.local_pct: edge count / games_with_next at the parent node
definitions.cumulative_pct: edge count / root cohort total games
definitions.outcomes: whole-game results from Skyrocoster's Black perspective
definitions.denominator_note: games ending at a node stay in its outcomes and games_without_next and are excluded only from next-move (local_pct) denominators

stop_reasons.below_min_support_20_games: stopped: reached by fewer than 20 games (minimum support)
stop_reasons.no_individual_move_above_10pct_local: stopped: no single immediate move exceeds 10% locally
stop_reasons.no_recorded_next_move: stopped: no game at this position has a recorded next move
